form.title: SegBench: frozen ROI imaging benchmark
form.description: Runs Baysor, ProSeg, Segger (GPU), SPLIT, cellAdmix and TRACER Seg on ONE frozen ROI. Coordinates, window size and occupancy rule come from roi_manifest_frozen.json and must not be changed here.

dataset_kind.title: Benchmark dataset kind
dataset_kind.description: Fixed: this process only runs the frozen-ROI imaging graph.

sample_name.title: Sample name
sample_name.description: Short label written into every receipt.

run_scope.title: Run scope
run_scope.description: Run smoke on each new platform before full. Smoke uses the Spot queue so an unavailable GPU cannot block the CPU methods.

seed.title: Frozen seed
seed.description: Locked analysis seed. Baysor v0.7.1 uses its hard-coded internal seed 1.

transcripts.title: Frozen ROI transcripts
transcripts.description: The frozen ROI parquet. This exact population is handed to every method; no method re-filters it.

pmi.title: cPMI panel
pmi.description: Platform-matched cPMI. Cervical panels are the delivered panel filtered by gene overlap only; CosMx and MERFISH panels are built once by the pinned builder and reused across every ROI.

reference_train.title: Training reference
reference_train.description: Training-only scRNA split. Staged into SPLIT and common-input preparation, never into the evaluator.

reference_holdout.title: Held-out evaluation reference
reference_holdout.description: Staged only into the evaluator. The same holdout scores every method. SPLIT must never see it.

reference_celltype_col.title: Reference cell-type column
reference_celltype_col.description: obs column in the scRNA reference. Cell_Cluster_level1 for the lung reference; cell_type for cervical and ileum.

roi_id.title: Frozen ROI id
roi_id.description: e.g. xenium5k_cervical__q50. Must match an entry in the frozen ROI manifest.

density_quantile.title: Density quantile
density_quantile.description: q50 is the primary comparison; q25/q75 are predefined density sensitivities, not tuning opportunities.

area_mm2.title: ROI area (mm2)
area_mm2.description: Physical area of the frozen window, used for entities per mm2. 0.25 for a 500 um square.

roi_manifest.title: Frozen ROI manifest
roi_manifest.description: Copied verbatim into every result so the coordinates travel with the numbers.

max_retries.title: OOM/transient retries
max_retries.description: Selected exits retry with attempt-scaled memory. Exit 1 is included because AWS Batch reports a container OOM as exit 1.

max_memory_gb.title: Retry memory cap (GiB)
max_memory_gb.description: Upper bound for large tasks. Raise for the Atera q75 ROI (3.34M transcripts).

r_method_memory_gb.title: SPLIT / cellAdmix base memory (GiB)
r_method_memory_gb.description: Multiplied by the attempt number. cellAdmix was SIGKILLed at 159.6 GiB against a 160 GiB request on Atera q25 (1.93M transcripts), so use 320 for the Atera ROIs.
